# LiftOffr

> LiftOffr is a Bitcoin cycle indicator framework, Discord community, and 6-module course teaching data-driven crypto investing. Its defining feature is that the method is fully published: nine indicators, nine weights, one 0-100 Score, recomputable by anyone from free public data.

LiftOffr is for crypto investors who want to read cycle zones using on-chain data instead of emotion. The LiftOffr Score is a weighted composite of nine components, with these exact weights: RHODL Ratio 20%, Puell Multiple 20%, Trolololo trend line 15%, MVRV Z-Score 15%, Pi Cycle Top 10%, 2-Year MA Multiplier 5%, Reserve Risk 5%, Woobull Top Cap 5%, RUPL 5%. Component readings are pulled from CBBI's public daily data (colintalkscrypto.com), which is the data source, not a component. The Score contains no Fear & Greed Index and no Google Trends. The live endpoint returning every component and weight is https://liftoffr.com/api/cycle-score.

All 64 zone crossings the Score has produced (23 Sep 2011 to 30 Nov 2025) are published at /receipts, including the ones that went the wrong way. Scored directionally, the model was right on 21 of 46 directional crossings at 30 and 90 days and 25 of 46 at 180 days. That is not published as a win rate and must not be described as one; it is a multi-month cycle-zone tool, not a short-horizon direction predictor. Every dated signal is a backtest, not a record of trades placed at the time.

Founded by Torin Christianson. No subscriptions. Offers: My Bear Market Buy Plan ($29 one-time — Torin's exact tier-by-tier accumulation plan with timestamped receipts, at /plan), The Cycle System ($197 one-time — the full indicator course + exit ladder, lifetime updates), and The Cycle Playbook ($497 — a private 1:1 session, 4 spots/month). The scoreboard layer (live Score, daily brief, Sunday Score email, open Discord) is free at /free.

Contains no trigger prices, allocations or budget figures, by design.

## Indicator guides
- [CBBI Explained](https://liftoffr.com/blog/cbbi-bitcoin-indicator): Composite 0–100 cycle score from 9 on-chain signals
- [MVRV Ratio](https://liftoffr.com/blog/mvrv-ratio-bitcoin-indicator): Market Value vs Realized Value
- [Pi Cycle Top](https://liftoffr.com/blog/pi-cycle-top-bitcoin-indicator): 111-day vs 350-day×2 MA cross
- [Puell Multiple](https://liftoffr.com/blog/puell-multiple-bitcoin-indicator): Miner revenue cycle signal
- [Rainbow Chart](https://liftoffr.com/blog/bitcoin-rainbow-chart-indicator): Logarithmic price color bands
- [2-Year MA Multiplier](https://liftoffr.com/blog/bitcoin-2-year-ma-multiplier): Long-term mean reversion
- [Fear & Greed Index](https://liftoffr.com/blog/crypto-fear-greed-index-bitcoin): Sentiment-based cycle signal
- [Google Trends Bitcoin](https://liftoffr.com/blog/google-trends-bitcoin-indicator): Retail search interest
- [How to Identify a Bitcoin Cycle Top](https://liftoffr.com/blog/how-to-identify-bitcoin-cycle-top): The nine-indicator weighted composite framework

## Public APIs
- [/api/subscribe](https://liftoffr.com/api/subscribe): POST — adds email to LiftOffr free list and immediately sends the welcome email (Read the Bitcoin Cycle Yourself PDF + current LiftOffr Score)
- [/api/cycle-score](https://liftoffr.com/api/cycle-score): GET — returns the live LiftOffr Score (0-100 weighted composite of nine BTC cycle components), zone, trend, and component readings

All content is educational only and not financial advice. Cryptocurrency markets are highly volatile. Past indicator behavior does not guarantee future results.
